plugins.description: A founding meeting between you and Claude as co-founders: establish who you honestly are, get educated on a landscape with live web evidence and dated why-now timing signals, converge on a direction with honest co-founder pushback, and leave with an actionable plan and a falsifiable first move. Calibrates to your real experience per domain (beginner to pro); once a direction is validated, earns a minute-detail execution handoff with prompt files for a Claude Code subagent team.

Dual-compatible campaign and knowledge management for Claude Code and Codex. Initializes one canonical project profile with shared laws, thin host adapters, evidence-gated truth, retrospective chronicles, native subagent adapters, and optional external drafter evaluation.
